name: APL Launcher
description: Apple-TV-style home screen: Top Shelf, glass dock, Control Center over any app, Settings and Sources. Needs Vetro on a rooted screen and Tizen 7 or newer: after install, open it and choose Settings › Remote and Devices › Set Up the Remote Buttons. Optional TMDB, YouTube and Fanart.tv keys are written into the package on install.

fields.label: TMDB API key (v3), for the live Top Shelf; optional
YouTube Data API v3 key, for TizenTube's Top Shelf; optional
Fanart.tv API key, for textless HD backgrounds; optional
